opening.argument: The video presents a concrete Firefox settings demonstration: it explains “how to change your default search. Engine in the Firefox web browser” and shows the Search settings page with a default-search dropdown and one-click search engines. Viewers are told that “in this drop-down you can choose which of these. Search engines that you want to be your default,” including alternatives such as Yahoo, Bing, and DuckDuckGo, and the speaker explains that the selected engine will search the entered term. The Amazon-link request is framed as ordinary channel support and remains separate from these instructions, with no described connection to financial participation, credential collection, deception, or harm.
